docs.title: Class plans: the 8-week starter course
docs.lede: Eight 45-minute classes for a group of four to eight kids, ages 7 to 11. They cover Stage 1 (Sprout) and Stage 2 (Explorer), the same lessons your students meet in the app.

docs.title: Class drills: the 8-week starter course
docs.lede: One printable page per class for the instructor, matched to the class plans. Every problem was made by the site's own generator and checked against the bead moves taught that week, so no child meets a move they have not learned.

docs.title: Pricing sheet
docs.lede: How to set your price for the 8-week starter course, the options to offer, and the plain math behind them. Your rates are yours to set.

docs.title: Parent flyer
docs.lede: Two versions of one flyer: a printed page for school pickup, and a post for parent groups online. Both follow Hook, Story, Offer. Fill in every [BRACKET] before you print or post.

docs.title: Sign-up script
docs.lede: What to say at school pickup, the texts that follow, the enrolment message, and short answers to the questions parents ask most. Read it out loud a few times. Then put it in your own words.

docs.title: Parent intake form
docs.lede: The short form each family fills in before class 1. Copy it into a Google Form or print it. It takes about two minutes.

docs.title: First-class checklist
docs.lede: Everything to do for class 1, in the order you do it: the weeks before, the day itself, and the day after. Tick each box. Most problems in a first class come from something that was not set up the week before.

docs.title: Progress report template
docs.lede: The one-page report each family gets after week 4 and after week 8. Fill it in from your class notes and the app, then send it within two days.
